matches.notes: Wikipedia and AfricanFootball.com agree on date (AfricanFootball header says 27 Oct, its text says Saturday 28 Oct), score 1-1 and all 11 Ahly starters (spelling variants Nagiub/Naguib, El-Sulaya). Zakaria 3' in both.
Wikipedia and ESPN agree on date, score and 11/11 Ahly starters (ESPN gives initials). Wydad won 2-1 on aggregate.

Single-match final; both sources list Al Ahly first (designated home) though played in Casablanca. Existing record 'Wydad AC 2-0 Al Ahly' (same date, no XI) is the same match. Ahly XI 10/11 by surname: Wikipedia 'Ahmed Abdel Kader' vs ESPN 'Ahmed Radwan' (same #35).
Wikipedia and Ahram agree on 4 June 2023 and 2-1; ESPN (Philippines edition) shows 5 June (time-zone rollover) but same score and 11/11 starters. Scorers Tau and Kahraba in Wikipedia and Ahram.
Date, score and 11/11 Ahly starters agree. ESPN credits Mohamed Abdelmonem 78'; the Wikipedia mirror text lists no scorers, so scorers dropped. Ahly won 3-2 on aggregate.

ESPN and Soccerway give 17 Oct 2020, 0-2; Al Ahly site report (posted 18 Oct 01:13) confirms. Ahly XI 11/11 between ESPN and the club's line-up post. Scorers Afsha and Maâloul (pen) in ESPN and club report.
ESPN and Soccer Laduma agree on 23 Oct 2020, 3-1 and Ahly scorers (Mohsen, El Shahat, Yasser Ibrahim). Ahly XI 11/11 between ESPN and the club line-up post. Ahly won 5-1 on aggregate.

ESPN and KickOff agree on 16 Apr 2022, 2-1 and Ahly scorers (El Solia pen, El Shahat). Ahly XI 11/11 between ESPN and club post (ESPN 'Ahmed Radwan' = Ahmed Abdel Kader, #35). Stadium not named; venue city only.

ESPN and Morocco World News give Friday 22 Apr 2022, 1-1 (Soccer Laduma report dated 23 Apr). Ahly XI 11/11 ESPN vs club post. Abdelmonem 44' in ESPN, Soccer Laduma and MWN. Ahly won 3-2 on aggregate.
ESPN, Btolat and SportEden agree on date, score and 11/11 Ahly starters. Scorers in ESPN and Btolat.
ESPN and Btolat agree on 29 Apr 2023, 0-0 and 11/11 Ahly starters. Ahly won 2-0 on aggregate.
Wikipedia and ESPN agree on date, Zamalek 1-2 Al Ahly and scorers El Solia 5', Magdy 86'. Ahly XI 11/11 Wikipedia vs club line-up post (ESPN line-up table unparseable).
Wikipedia and ESPN agree on date, 0-3 and scorers Sherif 53', Magdy 64', El Solia 74'. Ahly XI 11/11 Wikipedia vs Kaizer Chiefs line-up post.
Date, 0-0 and 11/11 Ahly starters agree.
Date, 1-0 and 11/11 Ahly starters agree. The only goal was an own goal by Espérance's Roger Aholou (4') in both sources, so no Ahly scorer listed. Ahly won 1-0 on aggregate.
Wikipedia and Sport24 agree on 10 Nov 2013, 2-0, scorers Aboutrika 54' and Abd El-Zaher (78'/79') and 11/11 starters. Ahly won 3-1 on aggregate.
Date (Saturday 2 Nov) and 1-1 agree. Only Wikipedia gives an XI, so lineup omitted; Capital FM does not name Ahly's scorer (Wikipedia: Aboutrika 14'), so scorers omitted.
Date, 1-1 and Ahly scorer El Sayed Hamdy (late) agree. Only Wikipedia gives an XI (a blog copy of BBC live text was not used), so lineup omitted.
Date, 1-2 and scorers agree (Al Jazeera names Gedo by his given name Mohamed Nagui). Only Wikipedia gives an XI, so lineup omitted. Ahly won 3-2 on aggregate.
